Since June 2021, successive and gradually larger increases in reference rate brought ex ante real policy rate to moderately restrictive level of about 4% by September 2022. This has been appropriately calibrated response to upward surprises to inflation and sequential delays in returning to target. Banxico has indicated intention to further increase policy rate.
